description:
Small QoL utility mod to add fast start options right on the new game creation screen and get to sector generation in one click. Created mostly for modders who need to reload the game a lot.

Mod requires LunaLib to use.

Due to need to run EFS for few frames after start for Auto Devmode and Safe Devmode, mod is not safe to remove until initial starting save is overwritten, if any of these features are enabled.

What mod does precisely?

Autosets the player name as "DevMode FastStart" (Or "Devmode NexFastStart" if Nexerelin is active). This also allows you to click `Continue` right away without inputting the name.
Note: UI panel doesn't update, but name is set.
Adds option on first screen to choice "Fast start", skipping pressing `Continue`.
Choosing fast start skips skill point distribution screen, and gives skill points after, if you still need them for testing.
Fast Start is equivalent to devmode start in stats.
Adds similar fast start for Nexerelin (and use its devmode start values).

Also supports few additional features changeable with LunaLib:

Auto Devmode on Campaign activates devmode after game creation or load. [Independent of start chosen and save loaded.]

Auto Devmode on Game App Stars activates devmode on Game App start up. Created as alternative to editing game settings or relying on hotkeys.

Safe Devmode enables devmode switching off before saving. Devmode is reenabled after save, so in most cases it should be seamless. [Should prevent crashes for mods which can't create saves with active devmode - like AotD "Vaults of Knowledge".]

Note: By default "Safe Devmode" is enabled, as I don't notice any negative effects from it.

New in v1.5

New fully user customisable start! Fill special string in mod's LunaSettings, and my code execute it!

Credits:
Vexlia Artemiss for being me and also mod author.

Alex for the original "NewGameDialogPluginImpl" code which my mod builds off and replaces.

Nexerelin authors for rulesCMD code I used to facilitate Nexerelin integration.

Bugatti Echelon for testing and finding bugs. And for being the main inspiration for part of the features.

discordPostHtml:
Small QoL utility mod to add fast start options right on the new game creation screen and get to sector generation in one click. Created mostly for modders who need to reload the game a lot.

Current list of features (as of version 1.5b)

Name autosetting - Mod autosets character name, which allows to progress from character screen right away.

New fast start right on character creation screen

  • 2 devmode fast starts for vanilla
  • 2 devmode fast start for Nexerelin
  • 1 fully user customisable sequence start, defined in mod's Lunalib settings.

Devmode associated features:

  • Auto Devmode on app start - Alternative to Lunalib hotkey or changing boolean directly
  • Auto Devmode on Campaing load - Activates devmode on any campaigh load
  • Safe devmode - Anti-crash feature, disabling devmode for a moment when game saves, proven to remove crashes for AotD)

For more detailed description check forum:
https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=34394.0

Download:
https://github.com/Vexlia-Artemiss/Vexlia-FasterDevStart/releases/latest/download/Vexlia.Faster.DevStart.zip
aiDescription: Provides quick-start buttons on the new game screen that bypass name entry and skill point distribution. It automatically sets developer mode stats and supports Nexerelin integration. Additional features like automatic devmode activation and safe saving are configurable via LunaLib.
removalCompatibilityText: Due to need to run EFS for few frames after start for Auto Devmode and Safe Devmode, mod is not safe to remove until initial starting save is overwritten, if any of these features are enabled.

changelog.1.5c:
- Done smart thing and made mod load before Nexerelin. Should fix any problems connected to Nexerelin updates for now and the future, until rulesCMD id change.
- Also used opportunity to refine some grammar in LunaSettings of the mod.
changelog.1.4a:
- Added alternative Nexerelin start which should be less prone to crashing.
- Added tooltips for all start options.
- Added non Lunalib config file, for anyone who want to use it.
- Added ability to enable devmode on Game App start as alternative to toggling it in Starsector's config.

- Changed some things in rules.csv.
- Fixed bug with mod disabling devmode.
changelog.1.3c:
Fixed bug with missing skill points.
Added story points to Nexerelin start.
